mean_source: distance slope of Nanshan post-fetch delivery conditional mean, refitted on all seven days
transfer_assumption: distance-associated travel component transfers to merchant-H and H-customer travel; distance-independent customer handoff and stops absorbed by fitted intercept are omitted from these travel legs
family_status: working exponential family assumption; mean estimated from proxy observations; first-leg family is not empirically identified

selectedcounts.source: Meituan-Shenzhen/深圳市南山区运单抽样_已脱敏.csv
selectedcounts.distance_definition: Euclidean local kilometres from raw anonymized coordinates; same H120 projection, no road factor
selectedcounts.time_definition: arrived_time minus fetch_time in minutes; strictly same-day payment < fetch < arrived
selectedcounts.window: canonical H120 12:00<=payment<13:00; both endpoints in 20km by 20km crop
selectedcounts.coordinate_note: zero projected distances retained: rounded/anonymized equal coordinates need not imply zero physical trip
selectedcounts.observed_scope: post-fetch delivery elapsed time, including unobserved stops and customer handoff
selectedcounts.unavailable: merchant-to-H events, GPS trajectory, road-path length, building entry and delivery handoff split

expected_max: a + mean*exp(-a/mean), with deterministic a when mean=0
diagnostics: Gamma and exponential checks refer to observed post-fetch delivery elapsed time only
